channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran conflict: Why has oil stayed near $100 a barrel?
item.description: The worst-case oil scenario has been avoided, but inflation and slower growth continue to weigh on the global economy.

item.title: What will the fallout be from the unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir?
item.description: Recent clashes between protesters and police killed at least 11 people.

item.title: ‘Anything but normal’: Uncertainty as Iranians try to get by amid US war
item.description: War damage and blockade have worsened economic conditions for many struggling Iranians.

item.title: Trump says Iran shot down US helicopter over Hormuz, vows to respond
item.description: US president says although the pilots were rescued, Washington 'must, of necessity, respond to this attack'.

item.title: Trump says in ‘final throes’ of peace deal but Israel kills 17 in Lebanon
item.description: The US president warned Netanyahu he would be on his own if attacks continue after Israel and Iran paused fighting.

item.title: Video captures Russian attack in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia
item.description: Surveillance camera video captured the moment a Russian drone strike caused a blast in Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine.

item.title: Trump says Iran shot down US helicopter and vows to respond
item.description: Two crew members of the Apache helicopter that crashed following the attack were rescued by an American sea drone.

item.title: Israeli air strikes hit Lebanese city of Tyre despite Iranian warning to stop attacks
item.description: Iran warned Israel on Monday that it could resume hostilities if attacks on its Lebanese ally Hezbollah do not stop.

item.title: Bowen: Trump and Netanyahu wanted to reshape the Middle East - now they risk a permacrisis
item.description: The US and Israeli leaders have lost control of the consequences after miscalculating the Iran war.

item.title: UK and allies sanction 'networks' enabling settler violence in West Bank
item.description: France will also bar far-right Israeli Minister Bezalel Smotrich from entry as part of the measures, which Israel condemns as "disgraceful".
